<function name="SetRollDelta" parent="CLuaParticle" type="classfunc">
	<description>Sets the rotation speed of the particle in radians. This should only be used for 2D particles.</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="rollDelta" type="number">The new rotation speed of the particle in radians.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
